text: Make a 10-second widescreen mood film: a lonely bus stop after rain, late at night. Melancholy but peaceful, with gentle movement. Completely silent, no dialogue or text. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?
